findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "books_depreciate" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "books" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account_set_owner_email, account_get_limits, account_search, account_get_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_save_team, account_data_locations · Private data: books_record_entry, books_record_expense, books_repay_claims, books_reverse_entry, books_attach_receipt, books_import_bank, books_save_bank_rule, books_report, books_export, account_owner_link, account_search, account_set_brand, account_export_all, account_audit_log, account_find_person, account_export_person, account_erase_person, account_data_locations · Public sink: books_setup, books_save_accounts, books_record_expense, books_repay_claims, account_set_owner_email, account_owner_link, account_get_limits, account_request_limit, account_emit_event, account_set_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_set_email_template, account_save_team, account_add_approval_rule, account_find_person, account_data_locations · Destructive: books_delete_bank_rule, books_apply_bank_rules, books_save_budget, books_delete_budget, books_depreciate, books_delete_asset, account_balance, account_add_approval_rule.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
